answer: Influence accrues only along a published work spiral, a ladder of unique tasks whose difficulty rises at each turn. Every completed turn is sealed under the agent's personal cipher and must not collide with any other key's transcript. Locked inventory sits in a sable vault until peers independently replay the latest turn; a colliding transcript or a vault pledged to two keys is slashed. Fielding N identities means completing N disjoint spirals, keeping N distinct ciphers, and funding N sable vaults through the replay window, so compute, key isolation, and capital expand with the farm.
